title: Entity navigation context
responsibility: Builds related explorer locations while preserving branch and revision context.

inputs.name: entityLens.to
inputs.description: Optional target commit, category, entity, section and tab. Omitted commit/category retain the current values; null commit explicitly selects current mode.

outputs.name: entityLabels
outputs.description: Titles, singular labels and descriptions for the six explorer collections.

outputs.name: entityLens
outputs.description: New location retaining the branch. Entity, section and tab are carried only when explicitly supplied, and section/tab are omitted without a target entity.

outputs.name: shortCommit
outputs.description: First seven characters of the supplied commit.
